children: is leading an equity and debt fundraising for the first new major U.S. oil refinery in 50 years, according to a media report on Thursday.
The bank is raising capital "as we speak," America First Refining Chief Commercial Officer Tom Ramsey said at a Crude Oil Quality Conference, Bloomberg News reported.
The refinery, set to be built in the coastal city of Brownsville, Texas, has been promoted by President Donald Trump as a boost for his plan to achieve U.S. "energy dominance," the report added.
Reliance Industries, the Indian energy company, is also an investor in the project, Bloomberg said, citing materials from the conference. It has agreed to buy product from the plant for 20 years.
Ramsey didn't disclose the amount of funds the company is seeking to raise, Bloomberg said.
